name: CaseBoxShadowOkStackInset
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "box-shadow-ok-stack-inset" (effects). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a THREE-layer elevation whose every layer colour is an OKLab spelling and whose last layer is an INSET hairline — the astryx `shadow-med` shape (examples/astryx/tokens/astryx.dtcg.json), minus the light-dark() mode fork the browser resolves at capture
